usage: tr [-h]
          {sessions,bars,facts,snapshot,news,screen,analyze,thesis,open,reconcile,grade,daily,report,slo,check,exp,usage,bakeoff,label}
          ...

tradingresearch: educational, not investment advice

positional arguments:
  {sessions,bars,facts,snapshot,news,screen,analyze,thesis,open,reconcile,grade,daily,report,slo,check,exp,usage,bakeoff,label}
    sessions            NYSE sessions ending at a date
    bars                fetch and store daily bars
    facts               framed EDGAR facts for one concept
    snapshot            indicators, levels and regime for one ticker-day
    news                stored Alpaca headlines for one ticker (untrusted
                        input)
    screen              code-only daily shortlist of the universe (no model
                        call)
    analyze             write a checked Analysis for one ticker-day (paid
                        call)
    thesis              write 0-3 checked theses or no-trades from a stored
                        Analysis (paid call)
    open                theses whose last event is PROPOSED or OPEN
    reconcile           settle PROPOSED and OPEN theses from raw bars (no
                        model call)
    grade               shadow baselines and grades for closed theses (no
                        model call)
    daily               the evening run for one session: screen, analyze,
                        thesis, reconcile, grade (paid)
    report              per-horizon scorecards: win rate, r_net, shadow,
                        power, P1 (no model call)
    slo                 check finish by 17:30 ET, zero missed sessions, fresh
                        data; exit 1 on a breach
    check               every claim of an analysis beside the source values it
                        cites
    exp                 experiments as config
    usage               the OpenRouter key's total spend so far (log it before
                        and after paid runs)
    bakeoff             the teacher bake-off: date-seeded draw and report (no
                        model call)
    label               blind P1 labels of graded theses and judge agreement
                        (no model call)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
